design.name: scheduled_invoke_unified
design.rule: Every .start() or .run() on a threading.Thread or threading.Timer binding (Name or inline constructor Call) resolves through one helper. The worker is invoked via follow_helper with construction-time literal args/kwargs from the scheduled record—never via a bindings-map sentinel. Synthetic func nodes carry mado_resolved only; callable_info returns it before any Name lookup.

ScheduledInvoke.scheduled: existing scheduled dict from assignment_binding or binding map
ScheduledInvoke.sync: true for .run(), false for .start() (reserved for evidence policy; both keep today's observed follow for sync worker defs)

types.mado_resolved: callable_info dict for target; set on ephemeral ast.Name or ast.Attribute stub, never stored in bindings

resolve_scheduled_invoke.site: spawn_scan loop head (replaces 2294-2311 and retires callable_info 1666-1667 thread_start)
logic: Require call.func Attribute with attr in (start, run)
If func.value is Name: binding must be kind scheduled
If func.value is Call: assignment_binding(..., cenv) must be kind scheduled

emit_scheduled_invoke.site: same module as follow_helper (new small function)
logic: target_info = scheduled.target; helper = target_info.node when kind helper
If args/kwargs not literal-ready: unparsed += 1 (same guard as 2303-2310)
Build bound_node = Call(func=stub, args=literal_nodes..., keywords=...); stub.mado_resolved = target_info
follow_helper(helper, bound_node, cenv, cbindings, ctx, depth, ...) — no local_bindings copy
If follow_helper returns None: sweep_body on helper (same as helper branch 2396-2398)
Do not downgrade to lead solely because sync=false (preserves AtkCallbackGlobal / frozen .start() behavior)

callable_info_guard.logic: if getattr(node, mado_resolved, None) is not None: return that dict
